To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
China TIMES can provide a detailed description of China’s energy system and can be used as a reference for the comparison of different global models and scenarios.

the transition to a low carbon energy system for China is technically feasible but requires substantial efforts to transform the economic growth mode and to speed up innovation and deployment of low carbon technologies.

China TIMES is a detailed model of the Chinese energy systems that provides useful insights into the energy system transition in China, and China can achieve a 40–45% carbon intensity reduction target by 2020 and can further reduce its carbon emissions by 50–60 % by 2030 and 70–80 % by 2050 compared with the 2005 levels, with the help of a combination of technological innovation and diffusion, and carbon pricing.

the global models are useful to identify the general trends in the energy system transitions, but they should be used with caution in the context of China, and China TIMES is a useful tool to check and validate the results of global models in the context of the China’s energy system transition.

China TIMES provides a good description of the Chinese economy and energy system, and the results from the China TIMES model are in general consistent with those from the four global models, but the results from China TIMES and the four global models are different, and the differences are not only due to the differences in model structures and modeling assumptions, but also to differences in model assumptions and in the definition of the reference scenario.

the energy system transformation in China is feasible and can be accomplished with a wide range of policy measures.
